functions.name: setPrefs
functions.description: Writes preferences the compose API does not expose (reply_on_top, sig_bottom, compose_html…).

functions.name: importMessages
functions.description: Imports messages into the inbox of the test account.

functions.name: setStorage
functions.description: Writes into the storage.local of another extension, which no API allows reaching from this one.

functions.name: openExtensionPage
functions.description: Opens a page of another extension in a tab. Returns its moz-extension URL.

functions.name: inspectComposeAction
functions.description: Describes the compose button of an extension and the panel carrying its popup. Does not open the popup: a toolbar button only obeys a trusted event.

functions.name: readPage
functions.description: Reads elements of an already open extension document, designated by a fragment of its URL.

functions.name: actOnPage
functions.description: Acts on an extension document: click, typing, checkbox, form submission.

functions.name: getStorage
functions.description: Reads the storage.local of another extension.

functions.name: consoleMessages
functions.description: Messages of the error console, the only way to see what failed in another extension.

functions.name: writeReport
functions.description: Writes the JSON report at the path held by the extensions.reply-position.reportPath pref. Returns that path.
